chapterInteraction.method: Actual in-page chapter link click handler

manualReviewStatus: Passed for the six representative layout screenshots and four stabilized video overview screenshots actually viewed.

manualVisualObservations.layouts: At 1440 and 390 widths, archive notice and all four replacement links wrap inside the page; entry and 2PC titles, player and learning guide remain legible. Mobile chapter chips use their intended horizontal scrolling container without document overflow.

videoOverviews.tx-2pc: Actual seven-node overview of preparation, save decision, applying, refusal and original-decision recovery; diagram visible without loading arc.
videoOverviews.tx-tcc: Actual reservation and mutually exclusive confirmation/cancellation overview; selected cancellation path visible without loading arc.
videoOverviews.tx-saga: Actual local charge, stock result, new refund, completed refund and pending recovery overview; no loading arc.
videoOverviews.tx-outbox: Actual joint save, background send, consumer checks, deduplication and failure/retry overview; no loading arc.

captureIssueAndResolution.observed: The first immediate paused-seek captures contained a transient native loading arc despite readyState=4, seeking=false, error=null and decoded video frames present. They were not accepted as unobstructed evidence.
captureIssueAndResolution.change: Only the external QA script waited 1200ms after seeked and requestVideoFrameCallback before capture; no website source, video, controls or error display was changed or hidden.
captureIssueAndResolution.result: All four replacement video screenshots were actually viewed by producer and independent visual reviewer; arc disappeared naturally and the original screenshot obstruction is closed.

independentVisualReview.scope: Actually viewed all four final updated video overview crops; no browser launch or file mutation.
independentVisualReview.status: Passed; transient arc absent in all four, correct topic and visible nodes/labels/edges.

limitations: Local final-build HTTP preview at port 4322 only; deployment/CDN checks are separate.
Automatic paused seeks and one brief chapter interaction do not constitute continuous full-length real-time playback.
Six representative layout images and four actual decoded video overview images were viewed; not every DOM state or every video frame was visually reviewed.
